## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (or rationale why none are needed)
- [ ] `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] `go test ./... -race -count=1` passes locally
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented (`README.md`, key bindings, help text)
- [ ] Breaking changes called out in the PR title and body
- [ ] If touching the shared store / projection logic, manual sanity check on a real `~/.lazyagent/store/`
